name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1958, Hindalco Industries Ltd. is a flagship company of the Aditya Birla Group. The Co and its subsidiaries are primarily engaged in the production of Aluminium and Copper. It is also engaged in the manufacturing of aluminium sheet, extrusion and light gauge products for use in packaging markets like beverage and food, can and foil products, etc.

ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Strong copper performance and revenue growth are currently masking a doubling of debt and persistent margin volatility within the Novelis segment.

promises.promise: Maintain consolidated net leverage at approximately 2x in the medium term.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show borrowings doubled in 3 years to ₹113,129 crore.
promises.why: Debt growth (2.0x) is outpacing the 15.5% 3-year operating profit CAGR.

promises.promise: Novelis long-term EBITDA per ton guidance of $600 remains intact.
promises.actual: Novelis recorded adjusted EBITDA of $516 per ton in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Current performance remains significantly below the $600 long-term target.

promises.promise: India capex spending of approximately ₹12,000 crores for FY27.
promises.actual: Management confirmed ₹12,000 crore spend for the current year in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Guidance has remained consistent across multiple quarters.

promises.promise: Copper segment to deliver normalized quarterly EBITDA of approximately ₹1,200 crores.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show copper EBITDA reached a record ₹1,673 crores in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Actual performance exceeded the normalized target by 39%.

promises.promise: Reach 884 megawatt renewable energy portfolio by the end of FY27.
promises.actual: Cumulative tree plantation reached 6.8 million; RE capacity progress not quantified this quarter.
promises.why: Target horizon is the end of the current fiscal year.

promises.promise: Permanently reduce Novelis cost structure by $350 million to $400 million.
promises.actual: Program is ongoing as part of long-term margin recovery strategy.
promises.why: Target completion is set for the end of FY28.

credibility.line: Management consistently exceeds copper targets but faces skepticism regarding debt containment and Novelis margin predictability following the Oswego fire.
